from collections.abc import Mapping
result = isinstance({"a": 1}, Mapping)
assert result is True
print(result)
README.md#1.rationale: Python 3.10 removed deprecated collections aliases for abstract base classes; import Mapping from collections.abc. Reference: https://docs.python.org/3.10/whatsnew/3.10.html#removed
